- Added `HeapEntryPending bool` (`heap_entry_pending` column) to the `AttachedFunction` struct.
- Added to `IAttachedFunctionDb`: `UpdateCompletionOffsetAndHeapEntry(id, collectionID, newOffset)` and `UpdateHeapEntryPending(id, pending)`.

### DAO — `go/pkg/sysdb/metastore/db/dao/task.go`
- `UpdateCompletionOffsetAndHeapEntry`: `UPDATE ... WHERE id = ? AND completion_offset < newOffset`, setting the offset and `heap_entry_pending = true`. Returns `ErrAttachedFunctionOffsetWouldRegress` when the guard matches no rows (offset would not advance). The guard is offset-only so a no-op can only mean a non-advancing offset.
- `UpdateHeapEntryPending`: updates the flag by id (idempotent).

### Mock — `.../dbmodel/mocks/IAttachedFunctionDb.go`
Added testify mock implementations for both new methods.

### Coordinator — `go/pkg/sysdb/coordinator/task.go`
- `TryFinishAsyncAttachedFunctionInvocation`: runs in a transaction — fetches the attached function by ID, its function record (`GetByID`), the collection record (`GetCollectionWithoutMetadata`), then calls `UpdateCompletionOffsetAndHeapEntry(af.ID, req.CollectionId, int64(req.NewCompletionOffset))`. Propagates the regress error; returns `NeedsRepair` (current log offset) when `collection.LogPosition > newOffset`, else `Success` (new offset). Update is called on every invocation.
- `FinalizeAsyncAttachedFunctionRepair`: parses the ID and calls `UpdateHeapEntryPending(id, false)`; idempotent.

### gRPC wiring — `go/pkg/sysdb/grpc/task_service.go`
Server handlers delegating both RPCs to the coordinator.
